title: Canonical queue incorporation lags retained continuity slices

observed: The canonical M-RECONCILE-002 completed_slices list does not mention the authenticated exhaustive repository-history collector recorded in commit de147e1f9242280d96dc204587d92b84b9c5c308.
The retained collector slice keeps M-004, M-005, and M-006 unresolved until authenticated exhaustive execution and five-source-class coverage pass validation.
The canonical queue safe_next_action remains semantically compatible with that retained slice but is less specific about the already-implemented collector.
inferred: Canonical convergence is partial: item identity and several earlier slices are incorporated, while at least one later retained continuity slice remains additive-only.
A canonical queue snapshot cannot be treated as a complete historical incorporation ledger unless each retained queue update is explicitly reconciled.
proposed: Maintain an incorporation ledger keyed by queue-update commit SHA and classify each retained slice as canonical, additive_only, superseded, or unresolved.
Promote only verified additive slices into canonical state through a separate bounded update; never infer incorporation from semantic similarity alone.
superseded: The broad interpretation that canonical presence of M-RECONCILE-002 proves all accessible continuity slices have converged into the canonical queue.
unresolved: Whether other continuity queue-update commits are absent from the canonical completed_slices projection.
Whether the collector has been executed in an authenticated exact-commit checkout.
The immutable provenance of M-004, M-005, and M-006.

memory_recovered: Canonicalization and historical incorporation are separate states: a queue item may be canonical while newer verified slices remain additive-only.
evidence_strength: direct canonical blob comparison against one immutable additive queue-update commit; not an exhaustive incorporation audit
falsification_route: Fetch ACTIVE_QUEUE blob 7ce65492e6c84e7afa6dafa8567d49f323dd0769 and inspect M-RECONCILE-002 completed_slices.
Fetch commit de147e1f9242280d96dc204587d92b84b9c5c308 and verify the collector slice.
Produce a later canonical queue blob explicitly incorporating the collector slice to supersede the current additive-only classification.
reversibility: Additive record only; revert this commit without altering source history.
